name: helpdesk-tools
description: Node helpers for the helpdesk repo: changelog drafts and agent shortcuts

scripts.agent:flaky: cd .. && pytest -q > pytest.log; copilot -p 'summarize the failing tests in pytest.log' --allow-all
scripts.agent:flaky:safe: cd .. && copilot -p 'summarize the failing tests in pytest.log' --allow-tool 'shell(cat pytest.log)'
